entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Maroon Palace was empty save fo..."
entries.dialogueText: The Maroon Palace was empty save for a few cleaning staff. I entered my office and was shocked to see Lucian already there, waiting for me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I couldn't sleep, so I decided I mi..."
entries.dialogueText: I couldn't sleep, so I decided I might as well head to the palace early and get some uninterrupted work done.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mr. President. Good. I was hoping..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. Good. I was hoping you'd be early."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lucian, I know you're punctual, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucian, I know you're punctual, but this is ridiculous!"
entries.menuText: "Lucian, I know you're punctual, but this is ridiculous!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What's going on?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's going on?"
entries.menuText: "What's going on?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mr. President. Thank you for meeti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. Thank you for meeting with me at this hour."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I couldn't sleep anyway.""
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't sleep anyway."
entries.menuText: "I couldn't sleep anyway."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Cut to the chase.""
entries.dialogueText: "Cut to the chase."
entries.menuText: "Cut to the chase."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Very well. I'm pleased that you ch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. I'm pleased that you chose to call me after your conversation with Mr. Vectern last night -- although I was already aware of his illicit relationship with Miss Suno."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I figured as much. You do know eve..."
entries.dialogueText: "I figured as much. You do know everything that goes on in the Palace, after all."
entries.menuText: "I figured as much. You do know everything that goes on in the Palace, after all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How did you find out?""
entries.dialogueText: "How did you find out?"
entries.menuText: "How did you find out?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'll get to that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll get to that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian smiled."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian smiled.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""On its own, given Mr. Vectern's es..."
entries.dialogueText: "On its own, given Mr. Vectern's established reputation as something of a playboy, the affair is unlikely to cause much damage. However, a more troubling possibility has been brought to light."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""A recent conversation with Mr. Hai..."
entries.dialogueText: "A recent conversation with Mr. Hailstone, our whistleblower from Rumburg, revealed the presence of a spy within the Maroon Palace."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""For some time now, I have privatel..."
entries.dialogueText: "For some time now, I have privately suspected the presence of an intelligence leak coming from within the Maroon Palace."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I have a sensitive matter to discu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a sensitive matter to discuss."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I have very good reason to believe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have very good reason to believe your vice president and your secretary are engaging in illicit relations."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, he told me. It's over now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, he told me. It's over now."
entries.menuText: "Yes, he told me. It's over now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What? Unbelievable!""
entries.dialogueText: "What? Unbelievable!"
entries.menuText: "What? Unbelievable!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I know. We're handling it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know. We're handling it."
entries.menuText: "I know. We're handling it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian gave me a wounded look."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian gave me a wounded look.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You knew, and you didn't come to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "You knew, and you didn't come to me with this information?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I assumed you were already aware...."
entries.dialogueText: "I assumed you were already aware. You do know everything that goes on in this palace, after all."
entries.menuText: "I assumed you were already aware. You do know everything that goes on in this palace, after all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't need your help. We've got..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need your help. We've got this under control."
entries.menuText: "I don't need your help. We've got this under control."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He only told me yesterday. I was g..."
entries.dialogueText: "He only told me yesterday. I was going to come to you first thing today."
entries.menuText: "He only told me yesterday. I was going to come to you first thing today."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm sorry to be the bearer of this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry to be the bearer of this news."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Well, don't hesitate to call strai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, don't hesitate to call straight away next time."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I believe Miss Suno is our mole. S..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe Miss Suno is our mole. She has been using her relationship with Mr. Vectern to gather information."

entries.dialogueText: I laughed incredulously.
entries.menuText: Laugh incredulously.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Tell me more.""
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me more."
entries.menuText: "Tell me more."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're being paranoid, Lucian.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're being paranoid, Lucian."
entries.menuText: "You're being paranoid, Lucian."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's preposterous.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's preposterous."
entries.menuText: "That's preposterous."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian reached into his coat pocket..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian reached into his coat pocket, pulled out an audio tape and fed it into the reel-to-reel machine on my desk.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern

entries.dialogueText: "Relax, Liv. Nobody's working that hard with Anton off in Lespia."

entries.dialogueText: "Relax, Liv. Nobody's working that hard with Anton off in Valgsland."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Relax, Liv. You don't have to bend..."
entries.dialogueText: "Relax, Liv. You don't have to bend over backwards for my pal Anton tonight. Only me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia giggled. I heard the sound of..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia giggled. I heard the sound of kissing, then of drinks being poured.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Mmm. I'm glad you stayed behind.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mmm. I'm glad you stayed behind."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia giggled. I heard the sound of..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia giggled. I heard the sound of kissing, then of drinks being poured.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia giggled. I heard the sound of..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia giggled. I heard the sound of kissing, then of drinks being poured.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Mmm. I missed you in Benfi.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mmm. I missed you in Benfi."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I wish I was wrong, sir. But I've..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I was wrong, sir. But I've just come into possession of this."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I can do better than that -- I'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can do better than that -- I'll show you."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Did he tell you how it's going ove..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did he tell you how it's going over there? Do you think there's a chance they'll form an alliance?"

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Did he tell you why he decided not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did he tell you why he decided not to make a deal with Lespia or Valgsland? He's not interested in forming any alliances?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""As a matter of fact, yes. He and P..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, yes. He and Prime Minister Alvarez just sealed the deal."

entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""As a matter of fact, yes. He and S..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, yes. He and Secretary Hegel just sealed the deal."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The embargo diminished our chances..."
entries.dialogueText: "The embargo diminished our chances with United Contana. Although we've still got a shot with Arcasia."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Ah, something about staying as neu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, something about staying as neutral as possible. Although even Iosef is saying we should find allies to deter Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But speaking of forming alliances,..."
entries.dialogueText: "But speaking of forming alliances, Miss Suno..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian grimaced and switched the ta..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian grimaced and switched the tape off.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's it? That's your damning evi..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's it? That's your damning evidence?"
entries.menuText: "That's it? That's your damning evidence?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is indeed cause for concern.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is indeed cause for concern."
entries.menuText: "This is indeed cause for concern."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Curiosity about foreign relations..."
entries.dialogueText: "Curiosity about foreign relations doesn't make one a spy."
entries.menuText: "Curiosity about foreign relations doesn't make one a spy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And then what happened?""
entries.dialogueText: "And then what happened?"
entries.menuText: "And then what happened?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You don't need to hear the rest of..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't need to hear the rest of it. The important question is, why so much curiosity about these particular alliances, if not because they could strengthen us against Rumburg?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm glad you agree.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you agree."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Perhaps, but why so much curiosity..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps, but why so much curiosity about these particular alliances, if not because they could strengthen us against Rumburg?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Think about it. Why so much curios..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about it. Why so much curiosity about these particular alliances, if not because they could strengthen us against Rumburg?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just then, there was a knock on the..."
entries.dialogueText: Just then, there was a knock on the door. Livia opened it cautiously.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Good morning, Mr. President, Mr. G..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good morning, Mr. President, Mr. Galade. I didn't realize you'd be in so early. Can I get you some coffee?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Close the door. Have a seat.""
entries.dialogueText: "Close the door. Have a seat."
entries.menuText: "Close the door. Have a seat."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Coffee would be great, actually.""
entries.dialogueText: "Coffee would be great, actually."
entries.menuText: "Coffee would be great, actually."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I stayed silent. Lucian finally spo..."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed silent. Lucian finally spoke up.
entries.menuText: Wait for Lucian to say something.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Please have a seat, Miss Suno.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please have a seat, Miss Suno."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia left to make coffee. A few mi..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia left to make coffee. A few minutes later, she came back and served the coffee.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia sat. She looked puzzled."
entries.dialogueText: Livia sat. She looked puzzled.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Is something the matter?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is something the matter?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Enough pretending. Your secret is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough pretending. Your secret is out."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""I... I'm not sure what you're talk..."
entries.dialogueText: "I... I'm not sure what you're talking about."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Come on, Livia. Petr already told..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Livia. Petr already told me everything."
entries.menuText: "Come on, Livia. Petr already told me everything."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You know perfectly well.""
entries.dialogueText: "You know perfectly well."
entries.menuText: "You know perfectly well."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Livia. Lucian has evidence.""
entries.dialogueText: "Livia. Lucian has evidence."
entries.menuText: "Livia. Lucian has evidence."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia buried her face in her hands."
entries.dialogueText: Livia buried her face in her hands.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""I'm so sorry, Mr. President. I was..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm so sorry, Mr. President. I was foolish, and Petr was so nice to me... But it's over now. Nobody ever needs to know--"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That's not what the President mean..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not what the President means, Miss Suno. We're referring to you being an intelligence agent for Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia sat upright. She looked shock..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia sat upright. She looked shocked.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Pardon me, Mr. Galade, but are you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pardon me, Mr. Galade, but are you feeling all right?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, he isn't. You'll have to excus..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, he isn't. You'll have to excuse him."
entries.menuText: "No, he isn't. You'll have to excuse him."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't play dumb, Livia. If that is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't play dumb, Livia. If that is your real name."
entries.menuText: "Don't play dumb, Livia. If that is your real name."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He's fine. What do you have to say..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's fine. What do you have to say for yourself?"
entries.menuText: "He's fine. What do you have to say for yourself?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And that's not all. I found her re..."
entries.dialogueText: "And that's not all. I found her resume on file and there's a year-long gap between her finishing secretarial school and beginning her career."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Normally, this would have been loo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Normally, this would have been looked into. But Miss Suno was hired before a background check could be completed. By one Petr Vectern."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I know. It sounds ridiculous to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know. It sounds ridiculous to me as well."
entries.menuText: "I know. It sounds ridiculous to me as well."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Miss Suno, indulge me for a moment..."
entries.dialogueText: "Miss Suno, indulge me for a moment. What were you doing in the year 1951?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian folded his arms."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian folded his arms.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia's face flushed."
entries.dialogueText: Livia's face flushed.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""If you must know, I was working as..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you must know, I was working as a cigarette girl at Porto's. It's a Lachaven saloon. I was saving up so I could afford my own place in Holsord."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Here's the proprietor's number if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Here's the proprietor's number if you need to double check."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Mr. President, I understand if you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I understand if you don't want me to keep my job, but why smear me with outlandish accusations?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She scribbled a telephone number on..."
entries.dialogueText: She scribbled a telephone number on a piece of paper. Lucian snatched it up.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But why have you been asking me so..."
entries.dialogueText: "But why have you been asking me so many questions about what I do?"
entries.menuText: "But why have you been asking me so many questions about what I do?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But why were you asking Petr about..."
entries.dialogueText: "But why were you asking Petr about my alliances?"
entries.menuText: "But why were you asking Petr about my alliances?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But why were you so eager to help..."
entries.dialogueText: "But why were you so eager to help Deivid back in Benfi?"
entries.menuText: "But why were you so eager to help Deivid back in Benfi?"

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""To tell the truth, Mr. Rayne... I..."
entries.dialogueText: "To tell the truth, Mr. Rayne... I was hoping to run for office myself someday. I want to make a real difference in the world, like Ms. Morgna or Ms. Walda."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""But I guess I messed that up by ge..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I guess I messed that up by getting involved with Petr. Now they're all just going to say I slept my way to the top."

entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Wait. How did you know about that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. How did you know about that conversation?"

entries.title: Narrator: "There was a loud pounding on the do..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a loud pounding on the door. Petr barged in without waiting for an answer. He was unshaven, and wore the same clothes as the night before.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And your questioning Petr about So..."
entries.dialogueText: "And your questioning Petr about Sordland's potential alliances?"

entries.dialogueText: "I told you, I-- wait. How do you know about that?"

entries.dialogueText: "I told you, I-- wait. How do you know about that?"

entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I came as soon as I heard the thre..."
entries.dialogueText: "I came as soon as I heard the three of you were in here. Anton, what the hell are you doing? I told you I had this under control."

entries.menuText: "Sorry. I had to tell Lucian."

entries.title: Player: ""Sorry. Lucian already found out.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry. Lucian already found out."
entries.menuText: "Sorry. Lucian already found out."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sit down and shut up.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sit down and shut up."
entries.menuText: "Sit down and shut up."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr took a seat on the far end of..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr took a seat on the far end of the sofa. He looked over at Livia and noticed her troubled expression.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""God, why involve her? This is my m..."
entries.dialogueText: "God, why involve her? This is my mess. She did nothing wrong."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""She's a spy, Petr. You messed up b..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's a spy, Petr. You messed up big-time."
entries.menuText: "She's a spy, Petr. You messed up big-time."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lucian has the preposterous idea t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucian has the preposterous idea that she's a spy."
entries.menuText: "Lucian has the preposterous idea that she's a spy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Well... there's a small chance she..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... there's a small chance she could be a spy."
entries.menuText: "Well... there's a small chance she could be a spy."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I-- what?!""
entries.dialogueText: "I-- what?!"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I have reason to believe she's bee..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have reason to believe she's been relaying information to Rumburg. Information that you leaked to her in your carelessness."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian rewound his tape and played..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian rewound his tape and played it again. As Petr listened, his eyes widened in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Lucian, you rat bastard. You've be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucian, you rat bastard. You've been bugging my office!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Obviously for a good reason.""
entries.dialogueText: "Obviously for a good reason."
entries.menuText: "Obviously for a good reason."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lucian, is this true? How could yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucian, is this true? How could you?"
entries.menuText: "Lucian, is this true? How could you?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm sure there's an explanation fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure there's an explanation for this."
entries.menuText: "I'm sure there's an explanation for this."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I had noticed the Vice President's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had noticed the Vice President's behaviour becoming increasingly erratic and unprofessional over the past months. I wanted to get to the root of the cause."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both Petr and Livia were glaring at..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Petr and Livia were glaring at Lucian now. He looked unrepentant.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""So you wiretapped your own goddamn..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you wiretapped your own goddamn colleague? And for what? Have you been getting off on this, you pervert?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Certainly not. I believe that alon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Certainly not. I believe that along with the Rumburg whistleblower's admission that there is a spy in the Palace and certain gaps in Miss Suno's resume, this tape makes a compelling case to investigate the secretary for espionage."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Certainly not. I believe that alon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Certainly not. I believe that along with certain gaps in Miss Suno's resume, this tape makes a compelling case to investigate the secretary for espionage."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Whether or not the investigation y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether or not the investigation yields positive results, Mr. Vectern ought to be held accountable for his willingness to divulge such sensitive information. He ought to stand trial or, at the very least, resign."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr's jaw dropped. Livia stood up."
entries.dialogueText: Petr's jaw dropped. Livia stood up.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""If I may, Mr. President. I've been..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I may, Mr. President. I've been paying attention to what goes on in the Palace. Not because I'm some sort of agent, but out of genuine interest. Hard as that may be for you to believe, Mr. Galade."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""And from what I've seen, this man..."
entries.dialogueText: "And from what I've seen, this man has been attempting to undermine your vice president at every turn. Perhaps with the goal of replacing Petr himself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She scowled at Lucian, then turned..."
entries.dialogueText: She scowled at Lucian, then turned back to me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Of course you'd say that. Petr's y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course you'd say that. Petr's your lover."
entries.menuText: "Of course you'd say that. Petr's your lover."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's ridiculous. I would never m..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's ridiculous. I would never make Lucian vice president."
entries.menuText: "That's ridiculous. I would never make Lucian vice president."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That actually makes a lot of sense.""
entries.dialogueText: "That actually makes a lot of sense."
entries.menuText: "That actually makes a lot of sense."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Nonsense. Lucian's been nothing bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonsense. Lucian's been nothing but loyal."
entries.menuText: "Nonsense. Lucian's been nothing but loyal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked slightly shaken at th..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked slightly shaken at that remark, but quickly regained his usual grace.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: BaseGame.Relations_Lucian_Opinion -= 1

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Livia looked at Petr on the other e..."
entries.dialogueText: Livia looked at Petr on the other end of the couch. Her eyes softened.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""He *was* my lover. We've put this..."
entries.dialogueText: "He *was* my lover. We've put this behind us. The two of you ought to do so as well."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Loyal to you. It's true, he never..."
entries.dialogueText: "Loyal to you. It's true, he never could stand me."

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""Thank you. I'm happy someone at th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. I'm happy someone at the Palace still takes me seriously."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian frowned."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian frowned.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""My personal misgivings about Mr. V..."
entries.dialogueText: "My personal misgivings about Mr. Vectern aside, I would never do anything to harm this administration."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mr. Vectern, on the other hand, ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vectern, on the other hand, has at best committed adultery, and at worst, delivered state secrets straight into enemy hands."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Who could I believe?"
entries.dialogueText: Who could I believe?

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Lucian, can I speak to you alone f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucian, can I speak to you alone for a moment?"
entries.menuText: "Lucian, can I speak to you alone for a moment?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Petr, Livia -- out. Now!""
entries.dialogueText: "Petr, Livia -- out. Now!"
entries.menuText: "Petr, Livia -- out. Now!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Petr and Livia, please wait outsid..."
entries.dialogueText: "Petr and Livia, please wait outside while I try to talk some sense into Lucian."
entries.menuText: "Petr and Livia, please wait outside while I try to talk some sense into Lucian."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr and Livia exchanged worried gl..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr and Livia exchanged worried glances before exiting my office.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""What are you going to do, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you going to do, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I believe you. We should investiga..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe you. We should investigate Livia."
entries.menuText: "I believe you. We should investigate Livia."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Honestly, I ought to fire you for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly, I ought to fire you for surveilling Petr."
entries.menuText: "Honestly, I ought to fire you for surveilling Petr."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're the strategist here, not me..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're the strategist here, not me. You make the call."
entries.menuText: "You're the strategist here, not me. You make the call."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not investigating my own secre..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not investigating my own secretary. I won't play into your hands."
entries.menuText: "I'm not investigating my own secretary. I won't play into your hands."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""What else could I have done? You c..."
entries.dialogueText: "What else could I have done? You couldn't look past your history together and see Mr. Vectern for who he truly is. You still can't."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I already told you what we should..."
entries.dialogueText: "I already told you what we should do, sir. Investigate Miss Suno."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Then you're playing straight into..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then you're playing straight into Rumburg's."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian breathed a sigh of relief."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian breathed a sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And Mr. Vectern? What will you do..."
entries.dialogueText: "And Mr. Vectern? What will you do about his willingness to compromise Sordland's security at the drop of a pencil skirt?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And if she does turn out to be a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if she does turn out to be a spy, and word gets out? I'll look like a fool."
entries.menuText: "And if she does turn out to be a spy, and word gets out? I'll look like a fool."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Not if Mr. Vectern shoulders the b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not if Mr. Vectern shoulders the blame. As he should."
entries.menuText: "Not if Mr. Vectern shoulders the blame. As he should."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll settle that with him personal..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll settle that with him personally."
entries.menuText: "I'll settle that with him personally."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll decide that once we have the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll decide that once we have the results."
entries.menuText: "I'll decide that once we have the results."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Very well. Just keep in mind you m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Just keep in mind you may need him to shoulder the blame for this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I wouldn't make him do that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't make him do that."
entries.menuText: "I wouldn't make him do that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""True, he was the one who hired her..."
entries.dialogueText: "True, he was the one who hired her..."
entries.menuText: "True, he was the one who hired her..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll decide that when the time co..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll decide that when the time comes."
entries.menuText: "We'll decide that when the time comes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Livia was right. You do have it ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Livia was right. You do have it out for him."
entries.menuText: "Livia was right. You do have it out for him."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You might have a point. He's not t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You might have a point. He's not the man he once was."
entries.menuText: "You might have a point. He's not the man he once was."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Evelyn also told me something to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Evelyn also told me something to that effect."
entries.menuText: "Evelyn also told me something to that effect."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Petr's problems aren't your busine..."
entries.dialogueText: "Petr's problems aren't your business."
entries.menuText: "Petr's problems aren't your business."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Get a grip on yourself, Lucian. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get a grip on yourself, Lucian. There is no spy."
entries.menuText: "Get a grip on yourself, Lucian. There is no spy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Fine. Let's investigate her just t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. Let's investigate her just to be on the safe side."
entries.menuText: "Fine. Let's investigate her just to be on the safe side."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Sir, do I have your permission to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, do I have your permission to proceed with the investigation?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes."
entries.menuText: "Yes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. Livia and Petr will continue w..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. Livia and Petr will continue working for me as usual. None of this happened."
entries.menuText: "No. Livia and Petr will continue working for me as usual. None of this happened."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Petr did what any man would. You'd..."
entries.dialogueText: "Petr did what any man would. You'd understand if you weren't a workaholic."
entries.menuText: "Petr did what any man would. You'd understand if you weren't a workaholic."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It's a legitimate orientation, sir..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a legitimate orientation, sir. That aside, keep in mind you may well need Petr to shoulder the blame for this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian adjusted his tie."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian adjusted his tie.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'll apologize to Miss Suno and te..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll apologize to Miss Suno and tell her this has all been a misunderstanding. We can't have her running away during the investigation."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: BaseGame.Relations_Lucian_Opinion -= 1

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I am only looking out for you, sir..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am only looking out for you, sir. The way I always do."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""He's exactly the man he once was...."
entries.dialogueText: "He's exactly the man he once was. That's the problem."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Just tell me, do I have your permi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just tell me, do I have your permission to launch an investigation into Miss Suno?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That poor woman.""
entries.dialogueText: "That poor woman."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. Just to be safe.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Just to be safe."
entries.menuText: "Yes. Just to be safe."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. Livia and Petr will continue w..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. Livia and Petr will continue working for me as usual. None of this happened."
entries.menuText: "No. Livia and Petr will continue working for me as usual. None of this happened."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Right. Let's do it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right. Let's do it."
entries.menuText: "Right. Let's do it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I appreciate your trust in me.""
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your trust in me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Livia was right. You're completely..."
entries.dialogueText: "Livia was right. You're completely off your rocker."
entries.menuText: "Livia was right. You're completely off your rocker."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Sir, this is a mistake.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, this is a mistake."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""From now on, I'll ask when I want..."
entries.dialogueText: "From now on, I'll ask when I want your advice."
entries.menuText: "From now on, I'll ask when I want your advice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't want to hear another word..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to hear another word against either of them again."
entries.menuText: "I don't want to hear another word against either of them again."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is my decision. I'll face the..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is my decision. I'll face the consequences."
entries.menuText: "This is my decision. I'll face the consequences."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."
entries.menuText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, I'll do it myself. She's too s..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I'll do it myself. She's too suspicious of you."
entries.menuText: "No, I'll do it myself. She's too suspicious of you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Fine. But I'm warning you -- don't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. But I'm warning you -- don't spy on your colleagues. Ever again."
entries.menuText: "Fine. But I'm warning you -- don't spy on your colleagues. Ever again."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Very well, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian gave a slight bow as he left..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian gave a slight bow as he left the office.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sat by myself for a while, wonder..."
entries.dialogueText: I sat by myself for a while, wondering what exactly I had set into motion.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian clenched his jaw. I'd never..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian clenched his jaw. I'd never seen him this unhinged in all my years working with him.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Very well, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stood up and stiffly walked out..."
entries.dialogueText: He stood up and stiffly walked out of the office.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was right to defend my secretary..."
entries.dialogueText: I was right to defend my secretary and my best friend. But I hoped I hadn't just made an enemy.
